correctness.rationale: Exact quotient equation and degree-three cover; sine-equality exhausts six critical points with three lifts each. Explicit Jacobians give 3 sinks/9 saddles/6 sources, all hyperbolic. Strict potential with zero derivative exactly at equilibria plus compactness and connected omega-limits proves every orbit converges. Equal saddle energy rules out saddle-to-saddle connections; all remaining stable/unstable manifold intersections are automatically transverse. The order-three deck translation permutes basins; their complement is finite unions of 1D manifolds and source points, so each has exactly one third of the torus area. Verified analytic identities and exact stationary spectra with standalone script.

value.rationale: This exact smallest nonpairwise motif has genuine multistability: an all-in-phase sink and two splay sinks, a nontrivial nine-saddle separatrix skeleton, and a basin area of exactly \(4\pi^2/3\) for each attractor. The global and quantitative basin classification supplies a mathematically natural finite-system benchmark for contemporary triadic-hypernetwork models and basin-stability studies; it is not merely a Jacobian computation or restatement of local synchrony.
